question: Where should those devoted to Kāmarāja worship remember these forms?
premises: The forms are to be remembered.
The practitioners are devoted to Kāmarāja worship.
The location specified is the heart-lotus.
inference: Those devoted to Kāmarāja worship should remember these forms in the heart-lotus.
plain_english: And those devoted to the worship of Kāmarāja should remember them in the lotus of the heart.
